text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's. One day, shortly 
after the turning of the year—

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Me...
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Phalaenopsis is here! 
Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. 
I look forward to our continued time 
together this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, Phalaenopsis and I had been 
invited to the club's New Year party.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! Come on, have a se...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer. 
...You arrived before me, I see. And 
furthermore—
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! Come on, have a se...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Why are you wearing a cooking apron?
choice_data_list: I figured I'd help out with the co...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh, an admirable sentiment.
choice_data_list: I was thinking of helping out with...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, in that case... 
I shall help as well. Where are extra 
hands needed?
choice_data_list: No, you're a guest today, so pleas...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
By that logic, are you not a guest as 
well? 
Do not dismiss an offer of goodwill so 
callously.
choice_data_list: No, you're our guest today, so jus...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come now, what are we preparing? Black 
beans? Kamaboko?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted her to relax without worry, 
especially for New Year's, 
but it felt wrong to douse her
enthusiasm. 
In this situation—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? 
If you say so, then I shall do just that.
choice_data_list: Still, I'll have them take it easy.
Ask her to keep the little girl fr...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: Alright... now all that's left is ...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...If they are making datemaki, should 
the ingredients 
not be passed through a sieve before 
cooking...?)
choice_data_list: All right... now all that's left i...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I was told to rest, but... 
should I get up just to tell them 
that...?)

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Me...
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The sieve! 
You forgot it! Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Good. 
Now, the next step is cooking it.)
choice_data_list: Ah, thank you so much! I completel...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait.
Is it wise to pour in that much? 
They should really reduce the amount—)
choice_data_list: Whoops, that was too much. Guess I...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Yes,
exactly. Half that amount is fine to 
start. 
Good, keep the flame low...—)
choice_data_list: Oops, that's too much. Guess I'll ...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ............Hm. This is hardly restful.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You're so good at this!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! 
Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The onishime is ready.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is it? If everyone at the club is to 
partake, 
then this amount is surely appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The seasoning turned out well, too. It 
seems making 
large batches to share with everyone
truly 
suits me best.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Would you care for a taste?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is the privilege of those who 
work the kitchen. 
The konjac in particular has soaked up
the 
flavors nicely, you know?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do keep this secret from the others, 
however.
choice_data_list: Well then, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try the konjac she recommended. 
...Delicious! The refined seasoning and 
savory, sweet 
dashi broth have seeped all the way 
through.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Is that so? 
I am glad to hear it.
choice_data_list: Delicious! Seriously, this is so good!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Truly, you are someone worth cooking 
for.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It seems you are short on players 
over there, yes? 
Very well. I shall be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Young Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yay, it's Big Sis Phaleno! 
Play with me, play with me!

text_block_list.name: Young Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's play hanetsuki! 
Hanetsuki! C'mon, please?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I do not mind. 
However, do not expect me to go easy on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hop! 
Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What is the matter? 
Are you already done, with your face 
covered in ink like that?

text_block_list.name: Young Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... No fair, no fair! 
Why won't you go easy on me?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but that is one request I 
cannot grant.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to stop here, that is fine as 
well. 
The choice is yours to make.

text_block_list.name: Young Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaaaah! 
One more time!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. You show great promise.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Trainer. 
The datemaki you prepared is quite 
exquisite.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it suits your taste!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Me...
text_block_list.text:
You really can do anything, can't you, 
Trainer? 
Say, how about coming to work for our
club 
too?!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Me...
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, figured. You're super busy, 
after all. 
...What about just once a month or 
something? How does that sound?
choice_data_list: No, right now I want to do my best...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Forgive me, but I would 
appreciate it 
if you did not try to lead them astray.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It would cause me quite a bit of trouble, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoyed a relaxing meal 
together with Phalaenopsis and everyone 
from the club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A little while later, as we finish up 
lunch 
and start cleaning up—

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That datemaki was amazing! 
I see why Phaleno-san is always praising 
you 
behind your back!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yup, totally! Lately, every single time 
Phaleno-san 
comes by the club, she's always singing 
your praises!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
"Though their dedication has always been 
sincere, 
their achievements have granted them 
newfound confidence of late."

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
"They are growing into a mighty tree, 
worthy of standing by my back. 
I eagerly await what the future holds for 
them." ...That's what she said!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Man, she really adores you, Trainer! 
To get high praise like that from 
Phaleno-san... is... uh... —eek.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it was meant as words of 
praise, 
broadcasting private conversations is 
hardly admirable behavior.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Sit yourself down right there.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: ......T-Trainer...!!
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
I'm sorry, but there's nothing I c...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: Sorry, there's nothing I can do.
I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the club's New Year's party wrapped 
up, Phalaenopsis and I 
stopped by a shrine for Hatsumode on our 
way back.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: For everyone's good health.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For that is not something one 
simply prays for.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay with that...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is something I shall win through 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my spirit is thoroughly 
restored. 
Shall we forge ahead this year as well?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Toward our grand ambition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began our Senior year, 
a chapter of vital importance to the both 
of us.
